But with regard to a Paschal lamb,
Shmuel held in accordance with … Rabbi Shimon,
Shmuel held in accordance with the opinion of Rabbi Shimon,
who said there are five sin-offerings that … die,
who said there are five sin-offerings that are left in isolation to die,

w.2: But with regard to a Paschal lamb

p: But Rabbi Shimon does not … at all … graze,
But Rabbi Shimon does not concede in any case at all that a sin-offering is left to graze,
it is sacrificed as a peace-offering.

w.16: it is … as a peace offering

p: And what does he teach us
who said that a Paschal lamb is sacrificed as a peace-offering only when it is found after slaughter,
with regard to a Paschal lamb,
it is offered as a peace-offering,
Shmuel holds in accordance with … Rabba,
Shmuel holds in accordance with the opinion of Rabba,

w.3: with regard to a Paschal lamb
w.12: is offered as a peace offering

p: a Paschal lamb is sacrificed as a peace-offering only when it was found after the slaughter … but if it was found before the slaughter,
a Paschal lamb is sacrificed as a peace-offering only when it was found after the slaughter of the replacement, but if it was found before the slaughter,

w.10: when it was found … it was found

p: Shmuel holds in accordance with … Rabbi
Shmuel holds in accordance with the opinion of Rabbi
goes to its death. … But according to Rabbi … all lost
goes to its death. The Gemara asks: But according to Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi all lost
whereas with regard to the Paschal lamb,
where it is lost before midday and found before midday it is left to graze … He held
where it is lost before midday and found before midday it is left to graze and is not sacrificed as a peace-offering. The Gemara answers: He held
and he held that midday determines

w.15: with regard to the Paschal lamb
w.23: it is left to graze … He held

p: or a male that is in its second year
is left to graze until it … becomes unfit,
is left to graze until it develops a blemish and becomes unfit,
sold and its money is used for free-will offerings
